segment.source: Renders one price and one action, with a short list of what is included underneath. There are no tiers to compare and no columns to align — the band exists to state a number and take the click. Use it for: a one-product shop page, a course fee, a flat-rate service, a single licence, a deposit. Prefer 'Plan Card' as soon as a second price exists, and 'Launch Offer Price' when a former price has to be crossed out beside the current one.
